---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new metric, analysis, or capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem would this solve?

Describe the research or operational need this feature addresses.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see — a new metric, an
additional output, a new analysis script, a CLI flag, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why you'd pick (or skip) them.

## References

Links to relevant literature (e.g. CHAOSS metric definitions, prior
mining-software-repositories work) or existing implementations.

## Additional context

Anything else — example output, mock-ups, data the change would unlock.
